verdict.rationale: Slack publishes a per-method API reference (e.g., the chat.postMessage page documenting arguments such as the URL-encoded blocks array) and an official OpenAPI spec for the Web API. Those could feed interactive tooling, but nothing in the evidence shows an in-docs 'try it' tester or runnable examples, and probes found no OpenAPI file at the docs domain. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable or executable code examples in the reference, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
